gazette_location.description_raw_en: Thoroughfare as shown coloured yellow on drawing No. KH3670B Commencing in the north western end of Ngau Chi Wan Village near Lung Cheung Road and running south-eastwards for about 240 metres and terminating near the proposed Ngau Chi Wan Market.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此街道在 KH 3670 B 號圖則上係用黃色標明，由牛池灣村之西北末端近龍翔道起，向東南伸展約二百四十米，至近擬設之牛池灣街市處止。

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Thoroughfare to the west of Kwai Chi Path as shown coloured blue on drawing No. KH3670B commencing at its junction with Lung Chi Path running south-westwards for about 25 metres and terminating with its junction on Lung Cheung Road.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此街道在貴池徑以西，在 KH 3670 B 號圖則上係以藍色標明，起點與龍池徑連接，向西南伸展約二十五米，至與龍翔道交接處止。

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Thoroughfare to the east of Fu Chi Path as shown coloured grey on drawing No. KH3670B commencing at its junction with Lung Chi Path running south-westwards for about 27 metres and terminating near the proposed rest garden.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此街道在富池徑以東，在 KH 3670 B 號圖則上係以灰色標明，起點與龍池徑連接，向西南伸展約二十七米，至近擬設之休憩花園處止。

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Thoroughfare to the east of Kwai Chi Path as shown coloured red on drawing No. KH3670B commencing at its junction with Lung Chi Path running south-westwards for about 50 metres to terminate at its junction with Lung Cheung Road.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此街道在貴池徑以東，在 KH 3670 B 號圖則上係以紅色標明，起點與龍池徑連接，向西南伸展約五十米，至與龍翔道交接處止。

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Thoroughfare as shown coloured brown on drawing No. KH3670B commencing at its junction with Kam Chi Path and running south-westwards for about 40 metres to terminate at its junction with Lung Cheung Road.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此街道在 KH 3670 B 號圖則上係以啡色標明，起點與金池徑連接，向西南伸展約四十米，至與龍翔道交接處止。

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Thoroughfare as shown coloured green on drawing No. KH3670B commencing at its junction with Wing Chi Path and running south-eastwards for about 117 metres to terminate near the proposed Ngau Chi Wan Market. This pedestrian way includes both sides of the proposed Village Square.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此街道在 KH 3670 B 號圖則上係以綠色標明，起點與榮池徑連接，向東南伸展約一百一十七米，至近擬設之牛池灣街市處止。此行人道範圍包括擬設之鄉村廣場兩旁。

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Thoroughfare as shown coloured orange on drawing No. KH3670B commencing at its junction with Wah Chi Path and running north-westwards for about 30 metres to terminate at its junction with Lung Cheung Road.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此街道在 KH 3670 B 號圖則上係以橙色標明，起點與華池徑連接，向西北伸展約三十米，至與龍翔道交接處止。
